input.summary: Define renewal mechanics, 30-day opt-out and cap renewal uplift
input.comment: [Playbook] The maintenance term is described only as "renewable" with no notice window and no limit on renewal pricing. We have set 12-month renewals with a 30-day non-renewal right and capped uplift at the lesser of CPI and 3%.

ops.oldText: For a renewable one-year term commencing upon the Maintenance Commencement Date,
ops.newText: For an initial one-year term commencing upon the Maintenance Commencement Date, and thereafter for successive twelve (12) month renewal terms unless either party gives thirty (30) calendar days written notice of non-renewal (any increase in maintenance fees on renewal not to exceed the lesser of CPI and three percent (3%)),

input.summary: Move governing law and venue to New York
input.comment: [Playbook] Nova Scotia is outside our accepted list. We have moved governing law and venue to New York (Delaware, California or England and Wales are acceptable fallbacks).

ops.oldText: (h) This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of Nova Scotia and the laws of Canada applicable in Nova Scotia. All disputes under this Agreement shall be subject to the non-exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Nova Scotia.
ops.newText: (h) This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York. All disputes under this Agreement shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York.

input.summary: Add affiliate/successor assignment carve-out for Sparkling
input.comment: [Playbook] We must be able to assign to an affiliate or to a successor in an M&A transaction without consent, and a change of control cannot give Garman a termination or re-pricing right; consent for other assignments should be subject to a reasonableness standard.

ops.oldText: (d) Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party.
ops.newText: (d) Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, provided that Sparkling may assign this Agreement without consent to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets, and no such assignment or change of control of Sparkling shall give Garman any right to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement.

ops.oldText: (c) not assign this Agreement or transfer, lease, export or grant a sublicence of the Work to any Person, except as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing;
ops.newText: (c) not assign this Agreement or transfer, lease, export or grant a sublicence of the Work to any Person, except to an affiliate of Sparkling or a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets, or as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing;

input.summary: Confirm Sparkling owns its data and licence back to paid-for Modifications
input.comment: [Playbook] Garman may keep its platform IP, but Section 13 as drafted also sweeps in the Modifications we pay for and says nothing about our data. We have added a data-ownership sentence and a perpetual licence back to Modifications and Improvements funded by us.

ops.text: Sparkling retains all right, title and interest in and to Sparkling's data and materials, including data converted for use with the Software pursuant to Section 4. Garman grants Sparkling a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, reproduce and modify the Modifications and Improvements paid for by Sparkling for Sparkling's internal business purposes. No joint ownership of any intellectual property is created by this Agreement.
